text:
jess: heads-up: customer reported duplicate provisional tokens after a streaming resume. looks like snapshot-hysteresis merge and routing fallback both created provisional ledger entries. cc @nate

nate: ouch. any logs? which pools?

jess: snippet:
INFO session=zzz111 resume snapshot=SNAP-314 ttl_expired=true route=low-latency fallback=overflow provisional=24
INFO ledger write provisional session=zzz111 tokens=24 origin=resume
INFO ledger write provisional session=zzz111 tokens=24 origin=fallback

karen: two writes in <1s. dedupe was supposed to catch this. suspect derived session_id differs across pools (per-pool HMAC keys).

sam: yup we've seen per-pool HMAC rotation cause non-canonical ids. canonicalization happens later so ledger dedupe misses.

nate: quick fix: add idempotency at ledger.write keyed by canonical_session_id when present; otherwise use best-effort HMAC and emit metric provisional.dedupe.miss.

karen: console change: surface a "resume-hysteresis-collision" event on session timeline and show a small counts card on route dashboard (count + last-seen id). helps support.

sam: rollout: put idempotency behind kill-switch, canary to 3 pools for 48h, then global. ops-bot: schedule migration to merge provisional duplicates for last 7d (dry-run first).

ops-bot: queued job merge-provisional-hysteresis-collisions (dry-run) range=2026-03-15..2026-03-22 estimate=~9k rows

jess: action items: karen PR for console + metric; sam PR for ledger idempotency + canonicalization; nate coordinate canary; ops-bot run dry-run. low-sev but customer-visible. :thumbsup:
